data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2022 (2021 GBP 5.7m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 184.872m. Using the gross claims development table, prior year development for older underwriting years (2018-2020) shows a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 3.42m (c.1.85% of opening reserves). Management note a net release of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance, and describe the movement as driven by favourable development in Property partially offset by adverse development on Legal Indemnities. No single large named catastrophe is identified as driving the movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2022 (2021 GBP 5.7m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not provided as a single gross figure in the movement note; a net release (GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance) is stated in the narrative. The reported gross PYD has been calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages cited) per the triangle-diagonal method described in instructions. As such the prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from the triangle (calculation confidence 0.8). No named catastrophe events were identified as drivers of prior-year movement in the text.
